title: GukiZ and Contest
statementMd:
Professor GukiZ likes programming contests. He especially likes to rate his students on the contests he prepares. Now, he has decided to prepare a new contest.

In total, $*n*$ students will attend, and before the start, every one of them has some positive integer rating. Students are indexed from $1$ to $*n*$. Let's denote the rating of $*i*$-th student as $*a*_{*i*}$. After the contest ends, every student will end up with some positive integer position. GukiZ expects that his students will take places according to their ratings.

He thinks that each student will take place equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8525cafdf358474b435e5d3d9562e6bc3bbbe6c5.png). In particular, if student $*A*$ has rating strictly lower then student $*B*$, $*A*$ will get the strictly better position than $*B*$, and if two students have equal ratings, they will share the same position.

GukiZ would like you to reconstruct the results by following his expectations. Help him and determine the position after the end of the contest for each of his students if everything goes as expected.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$), number of GukiZ's students.

The second line contains $*n*$ numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 2000$) where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the rating of $*i*$-th student ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$).

## Output

In a single line, print the position after the end of the contest for each of $*n*$ students in the same order as they appear in the input.

## Note

In the first sample, students $2$ and $3$ are positioned first (there is no other student with higher rating), and student $1$ is positioned third since there are two students with higher rating.

In the second sample, first student is the only one on the contest.

In the third sample, students $2$ and $5$ share the first position with highest rating, student $4$ is next with third position, and students $1$ and $3$ are the last sharing fourth position.
statementZhMd:
GukiZ 教授喜欢编程竞赛。他尤其喜欢在自己准备的竞赛中为学生评分。现在，他决定准备一场新的竞赛。

总共有 $*n*$ 名学生参加，在竞赛开始前，每名学生都有一个正整数评分。学生的编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。我们将第 $*i*$ 名学生的评分记为 $*a*_{*i*}$。竞赛结束后，每名学生都会获得一个正整数名次。GukiZ 认为他的学生将按照评分决定名次。

他认为每名学生的名次都将等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8525cafdf358474b435e5d3d9562e6bc3bbbe6c5.png)。特别地，如果学生 $*A*$ 的评分严格低于学生 $*B*$ 的评分，那么 $*A*$ 将获得严格优于 $*B*$ 的名次；如果两名学生的评分相同，那么他们将获得相同的名次。

GukiZ 希望根据他的预期还原竞赛结果。请你帮助他确定，如果一切都如预期进行，竞赛结束后每名学生的名次。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$），表示 GukiZ 的学生人数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 2000$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 名学生的评分（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

在一行中，按照输入中出现的顺序，输出 $*n*$ 名学生在竞赛结束后的名次。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，学生 $2$ 和 $3$ 并列第一（没有其他学生的评分更高），学生 $1$ 排名第三，因为有两名学生的评分高于他。

在第二个样例中，第一名学生是竞赛中唯一的学生。

在第三个样例中，学生 $2$ 和 $5$ 以最高评分并列第一，学生 $4$ 获得第三名，学生 $1$ 和 $3$ 以最后的第四名并列。
